name: Tabs
gloss: a strip of tabs, each its own address
test: the strip changes what the body holds
not_to_confuse: selector, which picks one item rather than one view

name: Second-level switch
gloss: a second strip, or a switch row, inside a tab
test: the row sits inside one tab and changes only that tab

name: Lede
gloss: one sentence under the tabs saying what the rows are
test: it names the rows; it does not instruct

name: Search box
gloss: a box that narrows the body as it is typed
test: typing removes rows from the body

name: Census line
gloss: one line of counts whose chips filter the body
test: a chip tap narrows the body
not_to_confuse: a legend, whose chips do not filter

name: Filter rail
gloss: a rail of groups, often a folder tree with counts rolled up, whose selection narrows the body
test: a pick narrows the body to one group
not_to_confuse: contents-rail, which jumps rather than narrows

name: Contents rail
gloss: one contents list drawn as a side rail where the width allows and a pinned bar where not; a pick scrolls to a place
test: a pick scrolls; nothing is hidden

name: Selector
gloss: chips, a grid or a menu that picks the ONE item the body draws: a table, a biennium, a document
test: the body draws exactly one of the choices

name: List
gloss: rows or entries, read by scanning
test: one entry per item; nothing else on screen draws an item in full

name: Grid
gloss: a sortable, filterable table, Tabulator or a hand table used as one
test: column headers that sort or filter

name: Card grid
gloss: one card per item, in a grid
test: each card is a complete small account of its item

name: List and detail
gloss: a list and one item's card, side by side or stacked
test: a pick redraws the card; the card shows exactly one item of the list
not_to_confuse: linked-swiper, where the card is itself a strip that moves the list

name: Linked list and swiper
gloss: a list, or a tab strip, and an inline strip of the items' cards, both on screen
test: a pick moves the strip AND a swipe moves the list's selection
not_to_confuse: header-swiper, whose top region is not an index

name: Header over swiper
gloss: a fixed region (a judgment, a guide, a question) over an inline strip of materials
test: the top region is about the set, not an index into it; no selection binding

name: Source beside claim
gloss: a document reader beside the material that cites it, with a divider
test: a cited item opens a place in the reader

name: Figure
gloss: a chart, map or matrix is the main region, with controls and a legend
test: the figure would remain if the controls were removed

name: Fields
gloss: one object's fields, labeled values and small tables, read top to bottom
test: a form usually draws this; the form field says whose

name: Document
gloss: prose or a rendered document, read top to bottom

name: Tool
gloss: an input and its output, where the reader acts rather than reads
test: the main region takes input

name: App split
gloss: two whole views side by side
test: each pane is an app view with its own address

name: Deck takeover
gloss: the list itself as a deck over the view or the window, at the tapped item, frozen at the tap
test: a swipe moves between the items of the list it was opened from

name: Docked deck
gloss: the same deck over part of the pane, the list keeping the rest
test: list and deck on screen together, the deck opened from that list

name: Drill
gloss: a deck one level down, covering its parent; the close button becomes a back arrow
test: the parent deck is under it

name: Record deck
gloss: a table's records, one per slide, every field shown
test: one slide per row of the table it came from

name: File deck
gloss: a changeset's files, one per slide
test: one slide per file

name: Peek
gloss: a card on hover or focus, sometimes pinned by a click
test: it opens without leaving the page

name: Row menu
gloss: a menu at the finger: read from here, copy
test: it opens at the tapped row

name: Expanding row
gloss: the row opens in place
test: the rows below it move down

name: Modal
gloss: a dialog or sheet over the page
test: the page behind cannot be used while it is open

name: Landing
gloss: a scroll to a target that tints and fades
test: the target is on the same page

name: None
gloss: the regions do not move each other

name: Select, show
gloss: a pick in one region redraws another

name: Two-way
gloss: moving either region moves the other

name: Filter
gloss: one region narrows another

name: Cite, land
gloss: an item opens a place in a document

name: Stamp
gloss: the state is written to the address, so a link reopens it

name: Same
gloss: nothing changes but the width

name: Stack
gloss: side by side becomes top over bottom

name: Hide
gloss: a region is dropped; the value is written hide:<region>

name: Switch
gloss: one region at a time, chosen by a control

name: Takeover
gloss: an inline region becomes a full-window deck

name: Wrap cost
gloss: a control wraps and pushes the body down by more than a screen
